title: Ensure AAP Inventory with Hosts
description: Ensures an organization and inventory exist in AAP, then adds all hosts from a comma‑separated list to that inventory, reporting per‑host results.

playbook_input.description: Parameters required to connect to AAP and define the target resources.

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: IP address or hostname of the AAP controller.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: Name of the AAP organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: Name of the AAP inventory to ensure exists within the organization.

parameters.name: hosts_list
parameters.description: Comma‑separated list of host names to ensure are present in the inventory.

playbook_output.description: Emits inventory name, organization name, list of hosts that were added, list of hosts that failed to add, and list of hosts that already existed.

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that were actually created (did not already exist).

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that could not be added.

fields.name: existing_hosts
fields.description: Hosts that already existed in the inventory.

steps.name: Look up existing organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API to find an organization with the given name.

steps.name: Does the organization already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether step-01 found a matching organization.
steps.condition: An organization matching the given name exists in the AAP controller.

steps.name: Create the organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent organization module.

steps.name: Look up existing inventory
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an inventory matching the given name inside the given organization.

steps.name: Does the inventory already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether step-04 found a matching inventory.
steps.condition: An inventory matching the given name exists in the given organization.

steps.name: Create the inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory using the idempotent inventory module.

steps.name: Split hosts list
steps.function: Convert the comma‑separated hosts_list parameter into a list of host names.

steps.name: Ensure hosts are present in inventory
steps.function: For each host in the provided list, attempt to add it to the inventory. Per‑host failures are captured; the playbook continues with remaining hosts and reports all results.

steps.name: Categorize host results
steps.function: From the per‑host loop results, extract three lists: hosts that were added (changed), hosts that failed, and hosts that already existed (unchanged).

computations._added_hosts: Collect host names from _host_results entries where the task succeeded and 'changed' is true.
computations._failed_hosts: Collect host names from _host_results entries where the task failed.
computations._existing_hosts: Collect host names from _host_results entries where the task succeeded and 'changed' is false.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the structured final result to the caller.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached when a non‑host step fails globally; prints the error block and halts the playbook.

phases.name: Pre‑checks
phases.description: Verify whether the organization and inventory already exist in AAP.

phases.name: Organization creation
phases.description: Create the organization if it does not already exist.

phases.name: Inventory creation
phases.description: Create the inventory if it does not already exist.

phases.name: Host addition
phases.description: Split the hosts list and add any missing hosts, collecting per‑host results.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Categorize host results and emit the final structured output.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Global failure handler – reached when a critical step fails, aborting the playbook.
